name: WhatsApp Assistant
summary: Local WhatsApp MCP server and agent plugin for selected text chats and separately confirmed replies in Codex, Claude Code and other local MCP clients on macOS.

requirements.client: local Codex, Claude Code or compatible stdio MCP client

suitableFor: Finding an intentionally selected existing WhatsApp chat
Summarizing selected recent text using the chosen AI client
Drafting a text reply and sending only after a new explicit recipient/text confirmation
Separately preauthorized narrowly scoped scheduled text sends
unsuitableFor: Official WhatsApp Business Platform integration or vendor-supported critical delivery
Bulk outreach, new-number sends or incoming-triggered automatic replies
Media downloads, calls or full-history archives
Windows/Linux runtime installation or cloud-only/remote/mobile clients
Offline AI or a promise that requested data never reaches an AI provider
limitations: Text reads are selected-chat, paginated and bounded to the last 30 days; incomplete history is reported
Unofficial OpenWA/WhatsApp Web integration may break or lead to account restrictions
The bridge has no TCP listener or own cloud relay; Chrome still connects to WhatsApp and tool data enters the chosen AI context
The host cannot cryptographically prove human confirmation or scheduler origin; bearer capabilities remain sensitive
GitHub source distribution only; packages remain private, not an npm-installed product
Own source MIT does not relicense OpenWA or other dependencies

evidence.automatedTests: 75 synthetic runtime regression tests passed under Node 22.13 and 24 before these documentation-only changes
evidence.liveAcceptance: Authorized default-runtime upgrade/restart, existing Codex tool path and dedicated-chat send confirmation with exact ID/text readback passed; fresh client installations, reboot/recovery and independent remote-device receipt pending
